svg.title: Native Q&A main workflow flowchart
svg.desc: A fixed-layout flowchart for Superpowers Project. Main workflow boxes are stacked on a centered rail. Implement Plan and Create Issues are peer routes. Orchestrate Issues and Resolve Issue are balanced under Create Issues as worker and direct routes. Revisit choices loop back to their originating skill. Stop pauses a continuation loop, while Done is reserved for verified final completion.
svg.text: Yes continues into the next depth. Revisit loops back. Stop means pause. Done means complete.
Use more than three questions or options
implementation, merge, audit, or align work
apply or prepare repair, then rerun Align
